verdict.rationale: Statsig documents an official MCP server for agent tools like Claude Code and Cursor, plus a Console API described as CRUD for actions otherwise done in the console UI. That plausibly lets an agent create analytics artifacts programmatically, and Metrics Explorer provides charting. However, no evidence explicitly shows dashboard creation through either interface, and no OpenAPI spec was found. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of dashboard create/update endpoints or MCP tools, evidence of adding metric charts to dashboards programmatically, hands-on corroboration of an agent building a dashboard end-to-end.
